name: Parked Light
designNote: Aha: the lantern doesn't have to move while Lune crosses. Sol pushes the lantern all the way to the cell over Lune's bridge and leaves it there; they walk back left together and Lune crosses in its shadow. Then Sol takes the mirror so he can go right while Lune waits at her goal, and sinks the lantern in the pit on the way.
hints: Lune's shadow bridge needs the lantern above it while she's on it.
Park the lantern over her bridge, walk back together, then use the mirror to part ways.
